_note: Source for the two Donna.AI demo agents on Retell. Prompts live in prompts/*.txt. `python3 retell_push.py build` writes the import-ready request bodies to retell/. ${NAME} placeholders are filled from environment variables by `retell_push.py push`; nothing secret is stored here. Cal.com booking tools are added in the Retell dashboard (connection-based integration), not here.

llm.begin_message: Thanks for calling Northbeam Heating and Plumbing, a made-up demo company from Donna.AI. I'm Donna, the AI receptionist, and this call is recorded. How can I help you today?

general_tools.name: end_call
general_tools.description: End the call after the wrap-up, or when the caller says goodbye.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's first name, if given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: The callback number the caller confirmed, in E.164 format (+1XXXXXXXXXX). Empty if not confirmed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_needed
post_call_analysis_data.description: What the caller needs, in a few words (for example: furnace not heating).

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller reported a gas smell, carbon monoxide alarm, no heat in cold weather, an active leak or flooding, a sewer backup, or a frozen or burst pipe.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a visit or quote was booked or demo-booked on this call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: The booked day and time in plain words (for example: Tuesday 9:30 a.m.). Empty if nothing was booked.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_ok
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the caller clearly said yes to receiving a text message.

post_call_analysis_data.name: wants_donna
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked how to get an AI receptionist like this for their own business.

llm.begin_message: Donna speaking — Donna.AI. Quick heads-up: I'm an AI, and this call is recorded. So you want to know what I'm about. Smart move. Tell me — what kind of business do you run?

general_tools.name: end_call
general_tools.description: End the call after the wrap-up, or when the caller says goodbye.

general_tools.name: switch_to_hvac_demo
general_tools.description: Switch to the Northbeam Heating & Plumbing demo receptionist, only after the caller agrees to hear the demo.
general_tools.execution_message_description: Great. Switching you to Northbeam Heating and Plumbing now. Pretend you're a customer whose furnace just quit.

general_tools.name: transfer_to_founder
general_tools.description: Transfer to the founder, only when the caller asks for a person and agrees to be transferred.

post_call_analysis_data.name: business_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's business name, if given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: business_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: The kind of business (for example: HVAC, plumbing, dental).

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: The callback number the caller confirmed, in E.164 format (+1XXXXXXXXXX). Empty if not confirmed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: avg_job_value
post_call_analysis_data.description: The average job value the caller said, in their words. Empty if not said.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a call with the founder or an audit was booked on this call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: The booked day and time in plain words. Empty if nothing was booked.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_ok
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the caller clearly said yes to receiving a text message.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked the founder to call back today.

post_call_analysis_data.name: lead_temperature
post_call_analysis_data.description: Hot: wants to book or start. Warm: interested, not ready. Cold: not interested or not a business owner.
